Commentary.Commentary: New Zealand bowlers bowled really well and never let the Indians run away with the game. Southee, Boult and Neesham did the job wonderfully. But it was Mitchell Santner who was superb with his figures of 36/1 in 10 overs. Ish Sodhi though was taken to the cleaners but he got the big fish in the name of Kohli. Right then, once again we didn't see the runs-flowing and New Zealand will know they have to bat really well to see this through. In the last 5 ODIs India have lost just 1 at this venue, let's see what happens tonight. Join us in a bit for the run chase.

Dhoni and Kohli then steadied the ship once again for India by accounting for a 71-run stand and once the Indian skipper departed, the run rate started to dip. Manish Pandey played a immature shot while Kohli got out against the run of play but not before playing a vital knock. Jadhav and Axar then played sensibly to take the score past the 260-run mark, a score that certainly could prove a fighting one on this deck.

A good comeback by the Kiwis after being blown away in the early stages of the game. They gave away just 70 runs and picked up 2 wickets in the final 10 overs! After winning the toss and opting to bat, Rahane once again started slowly and was sent packing via a soft dismissal. Rohit Sharma then along with Virat Kohli kept the scoreboard ticking but the former wasn't that fit and threw his wicket away in the quest of scoring quick runs.
Full toss on middle, Jadhav steps out and heaves it away to long on. Good running and they get a brace. INDIA FINISH ON 269/6.
Full and on leg stump, dug out to mid-wicket for a single.
JAYANT YADAV, the debutant, is the new man in.

OUT! SMART BOWLING! Slow yorker just outside off, Axar tries to dig it out but ends up getting an inside edge that shatters the stumps. Ends a valuable cameo from Axar. Gave the much-needed impetus in the end overs.
Length ball on off, Jadhav steps out to heave but gets it off the inside half towards long on for a single.

SIX! CHANGE OF BAT HAS WORKED! Slower ball outside off, Jadhav charges down the track and reads the variation well to slam it over wide long on for a maximum. Some momentum for the hosts all of a sudden.
Fuller around off, Axar heaves at it with all his might. One bounce to long on for a single.
Jadhav has a change of bats.
Slower ball outside off, Axar steers it towards short third man for a single.

SIX! THAT'S A BIGGIE! Axar uses the long handle to perfection. Picks the slower ball early and clobbers it down the ground over long on for a maximum. That made a cracking noise as soon as he made contact and it was only going one way after that. Timely strike for India.
Finally picks a slower ball properly and nails the pull to deep square leg. One bounce to the fielder as they take a single.
Length ball outside off, Axar looks to go big but gets a bottom edge to the off side for a single.
Slower ball on off, Jadhav muscles the pull towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Axar clobbers it towards long on for a single.
Full toss and Axar swings it to deep mid-wicket. Just a single.
Slower ball continues to confuse Jadhav as he gets an inside edge to short fine leg for a single.
Pitched up outside off, Axar squeezes it out down to long off for a single.
Full and outside off, Axar goes for the big shot but skews it high towards deep cover. Falls safe as the batsmen get a brace.
Fuller on middle and off, wrists it away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slower ball outside off, Jadhav tries to flash at it but is beaten by the lack of pace once more.
TRENT BOULT is back on.
Good length on off, Jadhav makes room and glides it towards short third man for a single.
Brilliant bowling this! Another slower ball outside off, Jadhav waits forever before flashing hard but misses.
Another slower short ball, Jadhav swivels for the pull but fails to make contact.
Fuller on off, Axar digs it back down the track to Southee who parries it towards mid on.
Another slower ball around off, Jadhav plays with an angled bat towards short third man for a single.
Slower ball on middle, Jadhav swivels and pulls it powerfully in front of square. Guptill in the deep makes a fab sliding stop. A brace added.
Slower ball on middle, Jadhav goes for the pull but gets a under edge to short fine leg for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, clipped down to fine leg for a single.
Good length on middle and leg, worked towards backward square leg for a single.
Slower ball around leg stump, Jadhav looks to sweep but misses.
Length ball outside off, Jadhav steps out and jabs it towards point for a single. Overthrow at the bowler's end as they take the second run.

BRAINFADE FROM JADHAV! Good length on off, gets across and dabs it on the track near the short leg region. He is down the track for a non-existent single and almost gives up. Neesham on his followthrough takes the ball but misses the direct hit.
JIMMY NEESHAM is back on.
FOUR! CLEVER BATTING! Fuller on middle, Axar shuffles and clips it sweetly past short fine leg to find the fence. Neat placement and that's a handy boundary for India.
Length ball on middle, Jadhav wrists it away to deep square leg for a single.
Slower ball on middle, Axar works it towards mid-wicket for a quick single.
Back of a length outside off, steered down to third man for a single.
Fuller on off, Axar goes across and driven down the ground to long on for a single.
Good length outside off, blocked off the back foot to the off side.
COREY ANDERSON is back on.
Loopy outside off, Jadhav goes back to cut but finds the man at point.
Flatter on middle, Axar gets across and clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Short and too wide outside off, Jadhav reaches it and slaps it down to long off for a single.
Flatter and short outside off, Patel goes back and chops it to backward point for a single.
Flatter on middle, Patel goes back to flick but cannot check his shot. Doesn't carry to short mid-wicket.
AXAR PATEL is the new man in.

OUT! HUGE WICKET! Floated outside off, Kohli steps out to play the lofted stroke but doesn't get his placement right. Finds Guptill at long off to perfection and he doesn't miss such easy chances. Massive strike for the tourists as the well-set Virat goes back, absolutely gutted at himself. This is the ideal situation for NZ to restrict India.
ISH SODHI comes back on to bowl.
Fuller on middle and leg, Kohli works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked away through mid-wicket for a single.
Slower bouncer around leg stump, Jadhav goes for the pull but misses.
FOUR! GOOD STROKE! Length ball outside off, Jadhav steps out to that one and lofts it cleanly down the ground. Well to the right of the mid off fielder as it races to the fence for a boundary.
Slower bouncer outside off, Kohli steps out and then adjusts to swat it down to long on for a single.
Back of a length on off, Jadhav rocks back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on leg stump, Kohli reaches out and pushes it gently through mid on as they go for a brace. The throw at the bowler's end was too wide as otherwise Jadhav would have been in trouble.
Loopy on a length outside off, Kohli dabs it towards short third man but cannot find the single.
Flatter on middle, worked to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! FINDS THE GAP THIS TIME! Short and outside off, Jadhav rocks back to that one and nails the cut to perfection. Splits the gap between short third man and point to get the boundary.
Drifting in from outside off, Jadhav is beaten on the late cut.
Fuller outside off, Kohli squeezes it out towards point for a single.
Full and outside off, Kohli steps out and then adjusts to steer it to third man for a single.
Slower bouncer again outside off, Jadhav shovels it to short mid-wicket for a single.
Slow bouncer outside off, ducks under it.
Back of a length on middle, Jadhav swats the pull through mid-wicket. Didn't time it that well but will get a brace. Good running, especially from Kohli.
Good length outside off, dabbed with soft hands towards short third man.
Fuller on off, Kohli steps out and pushes it towards the mid on region. Single taken and he wanted the second but Anderson charged in from the deep to prevent it. 200 UP FOR INDIA.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled. Five fielders are now allowed outside the ring.
TIM SOUTHEE is back on.
Drifting in from outside off, kept low as Jadhav is beaten on the cut.
Flighted outside off, defended well off the front foot.
Drifting in on middle, Jadhav works it to the leg side.
Fullish outside off, Kohli gets forward and pushes it down the ground to long off for a single.
Tossed up well outside off, Jadhav pushes it through the covers for a single.
Fuller on leg stump, Kohli works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated outside off, Kohli reaches out and pushes it towards cover. Jadhav was slow to start and Virat eggs him on to complete the single.
Flatter outside off, punched off the back foot to cover.
KEDAR JADHAV is the new man in.

OUT! POOR SHOT AND PANDEY DEPARTS! Floated on off, Pandey goes for the wild slog sweep but miscues it high towards deep mid-wicket. Boult hardly had to budge as he took the catch with ease. Needless shot by Manish as he had just come to the crease and it's never easy to start with a bang on this surface. A couple of quick strikes for NZ. Can they pull things back?
Beaten! Flighted on off, spinning away, Pandey is beaten on the drive.
Slider outside off, kept very low and Kohli whips it away down to long on for a single.
FOUR! THAT'S BLASTED AWAY! A bit short and outside off, Kohli sits back and punches it sweetly through the covers. Bisected the gap in the deep with finesse. One of Kohli's trademark strokes.
ISH SODHI is back on.
Drifting in around off, Pandey pushes it towards cover.
Flatter on leg stump, Pandey defends it firmly with a straight bat.
Floated on middle, Pandey makes room to push at it but gets the edge to point.
MANISH PANDEY is the new man in.

OUT! SANTNER STRIKES! Timely breakthrough for the Kiwis. Floated on middle, spinning away a bit and Dhoni misses the sweep to be rapped on the front pad. Appeal for lbw and it's upheld by the umpire. Ends a valuable partnership that has set things up well for India.
38th ODI fifty for Kohli.

Tossed up on off, wrists it away down the ground towards long on for a single. His love affair with Vizag continues. He has two centuries and a 99 before this game. And he's looking good today as well.
Floated on off, pushed off the front foot to point. Wanted the single but is sent back.
Pitched up on off, Kohli jams it out down to long on for a single.
Bye! Slower bouncer outside off, not much bounce as Dhoni leaves it alone. Watling fails to gather it cleanly and parries it behind square leg. The batsmen steal a single.
Well bowled by Boult! Sees Dhoni giving the charge and fires it very full. Dug out towards point.
Length ball angled in on off, punched off the back foot towards the bowler.
Dug in short just outside off, Dhoni watches it whiz past him.
Full and outside off, Kohli presses forward and blocks it to the covers for a quick single.
Kohli is having a change of gloves. Probably has sweaty hands due to the humidity.
Flighted outside off, Dhoni presses forward to that one and blocks it.
Slider outside off, Kohli reaches out and drives it down the ground to long off for a single.
Flighted on off, Kohli makes room and pushes it to extra cover.
Drops it on a length outside off, Dhoni sits back and slaps it to the right of the diving extra cover fielder. Down to long off for a single.
Flatter on off, punched off the back foot down to long on for a single.
A bit short and outside off, Kohli looks to cut but gets the outside edge to short third man.
MITCHELL SANTNER is back on.
Gets back and works it towards the leg side for a single.
On a length and around off, Dhoni pushes it towards covers for one.
Fuller in length on the pads, clipped towards short fine leg for a single.
Fuller in length and angling in, VK comes down the track and drives it towards the man at mid off.
Good length ball on off, MS pushes it towards covers for a single.
Angles it on middle, Kohli plays it uppishly towards towards mid on. It was in the air for a while but no damage done.
Comes forward to defend but fails to put bat on ball.
Length ball on middle and leg, tucked behind square and wanted two always.
FOUR! Pulled away with disdain! Touch short on middle, Dhoni swivels and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. He has scored a few boundaries in that zone already today.
In the air... dropped! Slower one on middle, Dhoni looks to flick but gets a leading edge back to the bowler who dives full length to his right but fails to grab that one. A chance goes down begging.
On a length and outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Good length on middle and leg, tucked towards square leg. They wanted a single but won't get it.
COREY ANDERSON is back on!
On the pads, tickled down to fine leg for a single.
Length ball on off, Virat punches it past the non-striker down to long on for one.
Comes down the track and punches it towards mid on.
Tickled down to fine leg for a single.
Fuller in length on off, driven towards mid off.
50-run stand is up between Dhoni and Kohli!
FOUR!  That's superbly done! Angles it on pads, Dhoni just helps it on its way with a paddle sweep down to fine leg for a boundary.
Half tracker on middle, Dhoni gets back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. 7 off the over!
SIX! BOLDSTARTS Stand and deliver! BOLDENDS Loopy ball around middle and off, Dhoni stays put and tonks it down the ground over long off for a maximum. The fielder there was a mute spectator.
Beaten! Loopy delivery around off, draws Dhoni forward to defend but the ball turns and goes past the outside edge to the keeper.
Short and outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Tossed up around middle and off, pushed towards covers.
Loopy ball around off, turning away. Dhoni looks to sweep but then decides it's better to leave it alone.
Drinks break!
Slower one on middle, Dhoni tucks it behind square on the leg side to keep strike.
Excellent running! Angles it on the pads, Dhoni clips it towards backward square leg and comes back for a double.
On a length and outside off, Dhoni punches it off the back foot towards covers.
Slower one on off, Dhoni punches it back to Southee.
On a length and around off, Dhoni drives it towards mid off.
Good length ball on middle, Kohli gets back and punches it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tim Southee is called back into the attack!
Around middle and off, Dhoni presses forward to defend but the ball turns away and goes past the blade to Watling.
Full and around off, driven towards covers.
FOUR! Sheer power! Tossed up ball around middle, Dhoni stays inside the crease and tonks it down to long on for a boundary. Brilliant shot and Sodhi is taken for aplenty now.
Fuller on middle and leg, flicked down to long on for one.
SIX! Huge, huge hit! Gives this a bit more flight around middle, Kohli skips down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and plonks it over Sodhi's head for a biggie all the way.
Turn and bounce! Outside off, turning away after pitching. Kohli tries to reach out to that one but is beaten by the turn.
Tossed up ball around off, pushes towards the man at covers.
FOUR! BOLDSTARTS Swept away fine! BOLDENDS Tossed up delivery around middle, Dhoni gets down on one knee and sweeps it beautifully through square leg and finds the fence.
Pushes it towards covers for one.
Comes down the track and flicks it towards backward square leg for a single.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Full around middle, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Eased down to long on for one.
Flatter one around off, Dhoni comes forward to play at it but gets beaten.
Tossed up around middle and off, Kohli punches it down the ground towards long on for a single.
Gets back and punches it on the up through point for a single.
Flatter through the air on off, punched off the back foot.
Tossed up around middle and off, pushed towards covers.
Slider outside off, defended well off the back foot.
Flatter outside off, Kohli looks to drive but gets an inside edge on to the pads.

REPRIEVE FOR KOHLI! Fuller on leg stump, Dhoni works it towards the leg side and calls his partner for a brisk single. substitute Bracewell swoops in on the ball but fails to throw it. Kohli puts in the dive but had that throw gone to the keeper's end, he was a goner.
Flatter on off, Dhoni lunges into it and nudges it towards short third man.
Flatter on leg stump, worked away through square leg for a single.
Fuller on off, Kohli looks to drive but gets it off the outer half towards point.
Floated up outside of, booming drive from Dhoni but it's well stopped at extra cover.
Tossed up outside off, Kohli drills it down to long off for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Dhoni opens the bat face to slice it through cover for a single. There was a mix up between the two batsmen but no harm done.
Short and outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover.
Fuller outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
In the air but safe...Short and spinning away outside off, Kohli goes for the cut but cannot keep it down. Just past Taylor at point as the ball rolls to the deep. Brace taken.
Tossed up on middle, Dhoni makes room and drills it through extra cover for a single.
Drifting in from around off, Dhoni sweeps it to square leg for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Dhoni reaches out and pushes it towards cover.
Darted in on middle, Dhoni is squared up a bit as he nudges it to cover.
Flatter on leg stump, punched off the back foot to long on for a single.
Fuller on leg stump, Kohli gets across and clips it to short mid-wicket.
MITCHELL SANTNER comes back on.
Flighted outside off, Dhoni presses forward and blocks it out to short cover.
A bit short and spinning away from outside off, Dhoni reaches out and steers it to point.
Loopy and very wide outside off, spinning away, Dhoni lets it pass expecting a wide but the umpire doesn't signal it.
Tossed up outside off, Dhoni reaches out and drives it down the ground to long off for a single.
A bit short and outside off, Dhoni hangs back to that one and hammers it towards wide long off for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Kohli reaches out to that one and drills it down the ground to long off for a single.
ISH SODHI is back on.
Fuller on leg stump, Dhoni gets across and tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, Dhoni reaches out and defends it well.
Length ball outside off, Kohli steps out to that one and cuts it through point for a single.
Fuller and on off, Kohli presses forward and blocks it solidly.
Shortish outside off, Dhoni stays back and cuts it away to sweeper cover for a single.
Full and on leg stump, Dhoni goes across and digs it out.
MS DHONI is the new man in.

OUT! GONE THIS TIME! Much-needed wicket for the Kiwis! Another short ball from Boult and once again Rohit miscues the pull. In the air and this time straight down Neesham's throat at deep mid-wicket. A tired shot and he departs after playing a breezy innings. Could have made a big one but probably fitness forced him to play differently. Timely strike for the New Zealanders.

Rohit's living a cat's life at the moment. Short ball and he goes for the pull but miscues it high towards deep mid-wicket. Just short of Neesham who covers a lot of ground to reach the ball but fails. Brace added.
Fuller on middle, Rohit gets across and digs it out towards short mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, Kohli steers it down to third man for a single.
Back of a length on off, Kohli gets back to that one and taps it on to the pitch.
Short of a length outside off, forced off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Shortish outside off, pushed off the back foot towards point.
Good length outside off, Kohli gets back to drive but gets an inside edge on to the pads.

DROPPED! NZ cannot afford to put down such chances. Length ball on off, Rohit goes for the heave but gets it off the inside half towards mid-wicket. Taylor puts down a dolly. He put down Kohli at Mohali and that cost the Kiwis big time. Will it happen this time too? Ross will hope not. Single taken meanwhile.
Back of a length outside off, Rohit stays back and jabs it towards short third man.
Shortish outside off, Rohit tries to repeat the stroke but this time gets it straight to short third man.
FOUR! Back of a length outside off, very wide and Rohit splits the gap between short third man and backward point to perfection with the late cut. Another boundary to the opener.
JIMMY NEESHAM comes back on.
Back of a length outside off, Rohit hangs back and opens the bat face to glide it down to third man for a run.
Fuller outside off, Kohli drives but gets it off the inside half through mid-wicket for a single.
Good length on off, Rohit makes room to drive it on the up through the covers but gets an under edge towards short fine leg. Single taken.
Length ball down the leg side, Kohli gets across and works it through square leg for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Rohit dabs it late down to third man for a single.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
TRENT BOULT comes back on for another spell.
Pitched up on middle, Kohli makes room and bunts it down to long off for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, Rohit gets across and works it to long on for a single.
Back of a length around off, Rohit looks to hack it away over the leg side but gets a thick inside edge down to fine leg where Sodhi puts a fine sliding stop. Brace added.
Back of a length outside off, Kohli nudges it to short third man for a single.
Length ball outside off, looks to run it down to third man but is beaten.

FOUR! KABOOM! Full and outside off, Kohli charges down the track and makes room to pummel the drive inside out through the covers to find the fence. That was struck very hard and he found the gap to perfection.

SIX! MAULED! Tossed up leg break outside off, Rohit goes down on one knee and slog sweeps it mercilessly over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. Tough shot to play, especially against the spin but that's this man's specialty - he can play unbelievable shots with minimum effort.
Slider outside off, Rohit hangs back and blocks it out to cover.
Flatter outside off, defended well off the back foot.
29th ODI fifty for Rohit.

FOUR! CUT AWAY! Drops it short and outside off, Rohit stays back to that one and slashes it away hard through point to find the fence. It's been a wonderfully paced knock from him so far. Took his time as usual early on and is now showing his full range.
Loopy on off, Rohit stays leg side of the ball and pushes it to cover.
Loopy leg break outside off, spinning away sharply, left alone to the keeper.

The physio is out there to attend to Rohit who seems to be having a slight niggle. This is taking a bit longer now and Simon Doull on air is visibly frustrated at what he calls an 'unacceptable hold up in play'. The lengthy treatment process is over and we are ready to resume. Rohit walks gingerly to take strike.
Pitched up on off, Rohit gets forward and pushes it towards point for a quick single. He seems to be limping a bit. He had fallen badly after the dive earlier in the over.
Back of a length on middle, Rohit stays back and blocks it out well.
Fuller on off, Rohit leans into it and drives it down the ground to long off for a single.
Pitched up on middle and leg, Sharma works it to mid on for a quick single. A direct hit at the bowler's end as Rohit puts in a dive to scrape through. They check for the run out but he's made it.
Direct hit at the bowler's end and they go upstairs. Rohit had to put in the dive but seemed okay to the naked eye.
Pitched up outside off, Kohli gets forward and drives it down the ground to long off for a single.
Full on middle and leg, Rohit gets across to flick it towards mid-wicket.
COREY ANDERSON comes on to bowl for the first time in the series. He has not bowled mostly as the team management wanted to ease him back after recovery.
Too short and spinning away from outside off, Rohit gets back and plays the late cut well past short third man for a brace.

SIX! CLEAN STRIKE! Rohit's gathering steam now in his innings. Sees this tossed up gently around off and goes for the lofted stroke down the ground. Didn't seem to have struck that well but still cleared long off with ease.
Drifting in on off, whips it away to long on for a single.

DROPPED! Very tough chance though. Tossed up outside off, Kohli looks to go hard at the ball but ends up hitting it flat back at the bowler. Sodhi isn't able to react in time and puts down the chance. Cannot really fault him for it.
A bit short and spinning away from well outside off, Rohit reaches out and cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Slider around off, pushed off the back foot towards short cover.
Drinks break...Good start for India. It was sedate early on but now runs seem to be coming at a fair clip.
Low full toss on leg stump, Rohit reaches out and drills it down the ground to long off for a single.
Quicker ball on off, Kohli gets across and clips it to short mid-wicket for a sharp single.
Loopy on off, Kohli presses forward and blocks it towards point.
Full and outside off, Rohit drives it down the ground to long off for a single.
Flighted outside off, Kohli leans forward and drills it to sweeper cover for a single.
Very full on off, Kohli manages to dig it out to the off side.
Quicker ball on off, blocked well off the back foot.
Loopy leg break outside off, Rohit looks to cut and gets a slice through point where the fielder gets a hand on it. Brace taken.
FOUR! Bad ball and hammered! Half-tracker on off, easy pickings for Rohit as he goes down on one knee to pull it over square leg. In the air but easily over the infield to find the fence.
Flatter on middle and off, defended well off the back foot.
Flatter on middle, worked away off his pads to square leg for a single. They look for the second run but Kohli slips and falls at the non-striker's end.
Drifting in from outside off, driven down the ground to long off for a single.
ISH SODHI comes on to bowl.
That was close! Darted in outside off, Kohli sits back to drive but mistimes it. Almost gave a return catch to Santner. The track is slowing down already.
Tossed up outside off, Rohit gets forward and thumps it down the ground to long off. Single taken.
Floated outside off, Kohli leans into it and drives it through the covers for a single.
Short and outside off, Rohit goes back and cuts it away to deep point for a single.
Fuller on off, Rohit blocks it out from the crease. That one skidded off the deck.
Floated outside off, Kohli stays back and steers it to point. Slight hesitation but they take the single eventually.
Slower ball outside off, Rohit checks his drive towards mid off.
Full toss outside off, Rohit leans forward and bunts it to mid off.
SIX! TREMENDOUS BLOW! Wow! Shortish outside off, Rohit just stands tall and punches it uppishly down the ground. Such power and elegance as it clears long off with ease. Top shot!
Fullish on the pads, Kohli flicks it away in front of square for a single.
Good length on leg stump, Rohit misses the flick and the ball rolls off the pads to square leg. A leg bye added.
Good length outside off, Rohit steers it to point.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked away to the leg side for a single.
Slider outside off, Rohit stays back and defends it well.
Drifting in from outside off, pushed off the back foot to cover.
Floated around off, blocked well from the crease.
HUGE APPEAL! Loopy around leg stump, straightens to rap Rohit on the pads as he is squared up totally. Lbw appeal but turned down. Pitched outside leg.
A bit short and on off, Kohli punches it off the back foot to wide long off for a single.
First signs of spin as MITCHELL SANTNER comes on to bowl.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. Four fielders can now be allowed outside the ring.
FOUR! SLASHED AWAY! Short and wide outside off, Rohit slashes hard at it and gets it comfortably over point. Hit it so well that it nearly went all the way. One bounce to the fence.
Slower and fuller outside off, Rohit presses forward and defends it out with the full face of the bat.
Good length on middle, shuffles across and clips it to the leg side for a sharp single.
Good length on off, Kohli looks to work it away on the leg side but gets a leading edge on it towards backward point.
VIRAT KOHLI walks out to bat.

OUT! RAHANE DEPARTS! Full and around off, goes across to flick it away but the ball probably stuck a bit off the deck. He ends up chipping it straight to Latham at short mid-wicket who takes it with ease. That's the early wicket New Zealand needed. One got a feeling that Rahane wasn't quite batting fluently.
Slower ball on the pads, Rohit is early into the flick and chips it uppishly through square leg. Single taken.
JIMMY NEESHAM has a change of ends. Williamson juggling his seamers around.
Good length outside off, defended well from the crease.
Another slower ball on the pads, clipped away behind square for a single.

Slower ball on off, shortish in length and Rohit goes over the top with a lofted shot. Doesn't time it that well but gets enough on it to clear mid-wicket. Falls safe as the batsmen get a brace. Good work in the deep by Santner.
Fuller on off, Rahane gets across and wrists it down the ground to long on for a single.
Pitched up outside off, aerial drive from Rahane. Just short of the man at cover.
Fuller outside off, blocked well
TIM SOUTHEE is back on.
Good length outside off, the release shot from Rahane as he glides it down to third man for a single.
Good length outside off, Rahane stays in the crease and dabs it towards backward point.

Five wides! MORE RUNS! Full and sliding down the leg side, Rahane isn't able to connect the flick. Watling dives to his left but cannot collect the ball either as it races to the fence. Bonus runs for India.
Shortish around off, Rahane stays back and taps it towards point.
FOUR! BEAUTIFUL SHOT! Slower and fuller outside off, Rahane picked it early and nailed it with an uppish drive comfortably over the covers. Made very good connection on the shot.
Good length angled in from around off, Rohit stays back and dabs it to cover-point for a quick single. Extra bounce for Boult.
Fuller on middle and off, Rahane gets across and whips it away through mid-wicket. Protection in the deep and so, just a single.
Good length on off, Rahane walks across the stumps and clips it to short fine leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, Rahane reaches out and blocks with a straight bat.
Slower ball on off, Rohit hangs back and nudges it to short mid-wicket for a quick single.
Full and outside off, Rahane leans forward and eases it to mid off for a single.
Wide! Full and sliding down the leg side, Rahane fails to connect the flick.
Length ball outside off, Rahane blocks it off the front foot.
Fuller on middle and leg, Rohit clips it to deep square leg for a single.
First change of the innings as JIMMY NEESHAM comes into the attack.
Good length around off, Rahane gets across and tucks it to short mid-wicket.
Fuller just outside off, Rahane looks for a hoick across the line but gets a thick inside edge on to the pads.
Length ball slanting in from middle stump, Rohit hangs back and jams it towards mid on for a single.
Almost a nick! Good length outside off, Rohit flirts at without any footwork and is lucky not to get an edge.
Fuller ball outside off, angling in, Rohit lets it pass.
Full and angled in from outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Another slower ball on off, Rahane leans into it and blocks.
Fuller outside off, Rahane presses forward and defends it well.
Full and outside off, driven firmly down the track. Southee gets a hand on it to parry it towards mid off.
Slower ball on the pads, Rohit waits for it and glances it down to fine leg for a single.
Dug in short by Southee and Rahane swivels to pull it through backward square leg for a single.
Wide! Full and down the leg side, doesn't connect the flick. Wide signalled.
Good length around off, Rahane gets across and clips it towards mid on.
Good length angling in around off, Rahane gets across and tucks it behind square for a run.
Good length on off, Rahane fails to connect the flick and is rapped high on the pads.
Full and angling in from around off, Rahane moves across and pushes it towards mid on.
Length ball outside off, Ajinkya reaches out and pushes it to cover.
Fuller and around off, Rahane looks to block but gets a thick inside edge on to the pads as the ball rolls to square leg.
Length ball outside off, Rahane looks to cut but gets a bottom edge to point.
Good reply from Southee! Attempted slower ball on leg stump, straightens a bit as Rohit misses the flick to be rapped on the pads. Loud lbw appeal but not given. Just missing leg.

FOUR! ROHIT HAS HAD ENOUGH! Full and around off, skips down the track to that one and lofts it cleanly over mid off. Cleared the infield comfortably as the ball raced to the fence for a boundary. Emphatic stuff from the opener.
EDGE DOESN'T CARRY! Full on middle, a bit of away swing as Rohit pushes tentatively at it. Gets the outside edge that just falls short of the man at wide slip.
Keeps it full and around off, Rohit gets across and blocks it down the track to the bowler.
Length ball outside off, stands tall and defends it firmly to the covers.
Good length outside off, Rohit gets behind the line and taps it towards point.
Fuller ball on off, Rahane gets across and defends it nicely.

FOUR! GLORIOUS SHOT! Full and outside off, width on offer and Rahane reaches out to flay it through the covers. Hit it on the up and timed it to real perfection. Already seems like a good batting surface.
Back of a length outside off, steered off the back foot towards point.
Pitched up on off, Rahane bunts it down the track to Boult who once again makes a half-stop as the ball rolls past him.
Another full ball on middle, Rahane covers the inswing and drives it back to Boult who gets a hand to parry it towards mid on.
Full and on middle, a bit of shape in, Rahane gets across to block it out.
TRENT BOULT to take the other new ball.
Length ball on the pads, Rahane gets across and flicks it behind square for a single.
Full and outside off, Rahane leans forward and pushes it towards point.
Fuller outside off, more outswing for Southee, Rahane chooses to let it pass.
Full and outside off, a bit of shape away, Rahane defends it nicely from the crease.
FOUR! CRACKING SHOT! A bit short and outside off, width on offer and Rahane stands tall to punch it on the up through cover-point. Timed it well and it raced across the turf to the fence.
Good length just outside off, Rahane jabs it off the back foot on to the track.

Time for the action to begin. It's pressure time now as both sides can ill afford a false step. The players are making their way out to the middle. ROHIT SHARMA and AJINKYA RAHANE to open the batting for India. TIM SOUTHEE to take the new ball for New Zealand.
The players are out there for their respective National Anthems.

KANE WILLIAMSON says that they are expecting dew a bit later on and hence losing the toss isn't much of a factor. Stresses that it's important to start well with the ball. Expresses happiness at having fought hard in the ODIs after a disappointing Test series. Says that it's been difficult to predict how the track will behave although the pitches have been fair. Reveals there is a change - Anderson comes in for Devcich.

MS DHONI says that they will bat first. Feels that it's a good track recollecting his domestic experiences of the venue. States that the track will slow down later on in all probability. Admits that it's a big game and opines that they haven't quite played to their potential just yet. When asked about the Indian players wearing their mother's names on their jersey today, he feels it's important to pay respect to one's mother daily. Reveals there are two changes - Bumrah and Jayant (debut) come in for Dhawal and Pandya.
Time for the toss. MS Dhoni to flip the coin. Heads is the call, it's a tail. INDIA WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO BAT.

It's been a thrilling ODI series so far and we are down to the decider in Vizag for the final match between India and New Zealand. Both sides have fought hard despite some glaring weaknesses for each team. It shall be interesting to see as to who will overcome their flaws better in this crucial contest. There is a cyclone threat looming around Vizag but for now, it's bright and sunny. The toss is coming up shortly.
